dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It must be difficult not being able to see.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Yes... Especially at the beginning, it was hard to adjust.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: But when you can't see, your sense of hearing becomes stronger. Now, when the wind brushes past my ears, I can almost picture certain things in my mind's eye...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: And since putting my faith in Lord Barbatos, I sometimes hear the whisper of a soothing voice carried on the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: My mother — or "Sister Grace" to everyone else — always tells me that Mondstadt is looked after by the Anemo Archon. I think she's right, you know.
